title: Admin Moderation System
description: Administrative endpoints, user controls, worker verifications, review moderations, and category management in Rozgar Connect
permissions: All admin endpoints are protected by requireAuth and requireRoles('admin') middleware gates.

dashboard.description: Fetches aggregate marketplace statistics (total users, total workers, verified/pending workers count, total reviews).

user_management.description: Retrieve list of all registered users.
Permanently deletes a user account from the database.
Toggles 'isActive' true/false. Deactivating an account immediately blocks the user's login and session refreshing capabilities, and hides their profile from search.

worker_management.description: Retrieve list of all worker profiles (along with verification card paths).
Permanently deletes a worker's profile document.
Approves a worker. Sets verificationStatus to 'verified' and isVerified to true, displaying the verification checkmark badge publicly.
Rejects verification details. Sets verificationStatus to 'rejected' and isVerified to false.

review_moderation.description: Deletes a review comment (triggers rating recalculation).
Modifies a review's rating or comment (triggers rating recalculation).

category_management.description: Adds a new custom service category.
Updates details (name, label, icons) of an existing work category.
Deletes a category from the database.

notes: A seed route '/api/v1/admin/seed' (POST) is available for developers to automatically register a default admin account during project setup.
